# Analyze the relationship between introduction pathways and mean residence time (mrt)
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Create a boxplot to visualize the distribution of mrt by introduction pathway
sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='mrt', data=invasion_df)
plt.title('Distribution of Mean Residence Time (mrt) by Introduction Pathway')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Mean Residence Time (mrt)')
plt.show()

# Perform ANOVA to test for significant differences in mrt across introduction pathways
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.formula.api import ols

# Fit the model
model = ols('mrt ~ C(intro.pathway)', data=invasion_df).fit()

# Perform ANOVA
anova_table = sm.stats.anova_lm(model, typ=2)
anova_table

# Perform ANOVA using scipy.stats
from scipy.stats import f_oneway

# Extract mrt values for each pathway
gardening_mrt = invasion_df[invasion_df['intro.pathway'] == 'Gardening']['mrt']
unintentional_mrt = invasion_df[invasion_df['intro.pathway'] == 'Unintentional']['mrt']
agri_forest_mrt = invasion_df[invasion_df['intro.pathway'] == 'AgriForest']['mrt']

# Perform one-way ANOVA
f_statistic, p_value = f_oneway(gardening_mrt, unintentional_mrt, agri_forest_mrt)
f_statistic, p_value

# Analyze the relationship between mrt and invasion success metrics
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Scatter plot of mrt vs. number of invaded plots
sns.scatterplot(x='mrt', y='number.of.invaded.plots', data=invasion_df)
plt.title('Relationship between Mean Residence Time (mrt) and Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.xlabel('Mean Residence Time (mrt)')
plt.ylabel('Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.show()

# Scatter plot of mrt vs. invaded niche breadth
sns.scatterplot(x='mrt', y='invaded.niche.breadth', data=invasion_df)
plt.title('Relationship between Mean Residence Time (mrt) and Invaded Niche Breadth')
plt.xlabel('Mean Residence Time (mrt)')
plt.ylabel('Invaded Niche Breadth')
plt.show()

# Perform linear regression analysis between mrt and number of invaded plots
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Prepare the data for regression
X_mrt = invasion_df[['mrt']].values.reshape(-1, 1)  # Predictor
y_invaded_plots = invasion_df['number.of.invaded.plots'].values  # Response

# Create a linear regression model
model_invaded_plots = LinearRegression()
model_invaded_plots.fit(X_mrt, y_invaded_plots)

# Get the coefficient and p-value
coefficient_invaded_plots = model_invaded_plots.coef_[0]
p_value_invaded_plots = model_invaded_plots.score(X_mrt, y_invaded_plots)

# Perform linear regression analysis between mrt and invaded niche breadth
y_invaded_niche_breadth = invasion_df['invaded.niche.breadth'].values  # Response

# Create a linear regression model
model_invaded_niche_breadth = LinearRegression()
model_invaded_niche_breadth.fit(X_mrt, y_invaded_niche_breadth)

# Get the coefficient and p-value
coefficient_invaded_niche_breadth = model_invaded_niche_breadth.coef_[0]
p_value_invaded_niche_breadth = model_invaded_niche_breadth.score(X_mrt, y_invaded_niche_breadth)

coefficient_invaded_plots, p_value_invaded_plots, coefficient_invaded_niche_breadth, p_value_invaded_niche_breadth
